coverage_note: Only individual votes explicitly named in official minutes are attributed. The 25 February 2026 Budget Council minutes record the FINAL AMENDED budget motion, not separate votes on every amendment. Current ward councillors elected after that meeting or not on its named list correctly have no vote shown. The council records other decisions without an individually named vote. Verify current councillors against the council directory if there has been a by-election or change.
